EOI - Malawi - Consultancy Services For The Probity Advisory Services for the Direct Contracting of the Epc Contractor for Kapichira PHASE I Rehabilitation and Modernization Works - Rehabilitation of Kapichira 1 Power Station
22-Apr-2026
The Republic of Malawi has received financing from the African Development Bank toward the cost of the Rehabilitation of Kapichira I and Nkula-B Hydropower Plants, and intends to apply part of the agreed amount for this grant to payments under the contract for Consultancy Services for the Probity Advisory for the Direct Contracting of the EPC Contractor for Kapichira Phase I Rehabilitation and Modernization Works (Probity Advisory Consultant)
